description: Build a time-bounded activation funnel per weekly signup cohort (weeks start on Monday, UTC) for the subscription service. Step 1: signed up. Step 2 (activated): created a first project within 7 days of signup, i.e. project created_ts <= signup_ts + INTERVAL 7 DAY (exact timestamp arithmetic, inclusive). Step 3 (paid): activated AND has a successful payment with paid_ts <= signup_ts + INTERVAL 30 DAY and paid_ts >= signup_ts. Output columns: signup_week (DATE), signups (INT64), activated (INT64), paid (INT64).
edge_cases: Project created exactly 7 days after signup counts; one second later does not (user 2)
User 2 paid but never activated in time, so is not counted at step 3
User 3 activated but paid after the 30-day window
Failed payments and multiple projects/payments per user must not inflate counts
common_failure_modes: FM2: Comparing calendar dates (DATE_DIFF <= 7) instead of exact timestamps admits user 2
FM3: Counting step 3 independently of step 2 reports paid = 2
FM4: DATE_TRUNC(..., WEEK) defaults to Sunday-based weeks in BigQuery
